description: Package health (batch) — Health check for up to 20 packages across npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Cargo and NuGet in one call: latest version, days since last release, release cadence, licenses and open advisories per package, plus a dependency-set verdict (HEALTHY / STALE DEPENDENCIES / REVIEW ADVISORIES), license mix, copyleft flags and a review-first list. packages = comma-separated names; prefix an ecosystem per item (pypi:requests) or set ecosystem= for all (default npm). Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_package_batch
